overview: AURA AI is a premium AI-powered personal assistant with a luxurious gold and black theme. It combines daily routine planning, task and goal management, AI chat guidance, focus mode, and motivational notifications into one elegant, mobile-first web app.
features: Daily routine scheduler with smart reminders
AI chat assistant with personalized suggestions
Task & goal manager with progress tracking
Focus mode with Pomodoro and Deep Work timers
Dashboard with daily stats and streak tracking
Browser notifications for routines and motivation
Glassmorphism UI with gold glow effects and smooth animations
Offline-first local storage for all core data
Theme customization with dark gold variations
